UnitStatement: The kty-metadata-align skill is used with a generic TASK shell and no profile.
A kty-metadata-align task aligns one KTY metadata set after DOMAIN regeneration.
The brief schema identifies ORCHESTRATOR as the requester for kty-metadata-align dispatches.
ScopePath is an absolute path to the target KTY folder.
TaskSkill must be set to kty-metadata-align for this skill.
AllowedWriteTargets for a metadata alignment task are a narrow list of metadata files and an optional report path.
RuntimeOverrides.KTY_PATH is required and points to one KTY folder.
RuntimeOverrides.DECOMPOSITION_REF is required and points to the decomposition truth source.
RuntimeOverrides.SOURCES_ROOT is optional and resolves authoritative source pointers.
RuntimeOverrides.REVIEW_OUTPUT_PATH is optional and points to the metadata alignment review output.
RuntimeOverrides.MODE selects either report-only review or metadata alignment.
RuntimeOverrides.REWRITE_REFERENCES controls whether _REFERENCES.md is rewritten.
RuntimeOverrides.ALLOW_STATUS_APPEND controls whether _STATUS.md may receive an append-only update.
The TaskSkill field value must match the skill folder name.
ScopePath normally equals KTY_PATH.
AllowedWriteTargets are limited to metadata files and an optional report path within single-KTY scope.
KTY_PATH is a required absolute path to one KTY folder.
DECOMPOSITION_REF is a required decomposition truth source.
MODE is required and must be REPORT_ONLY or ALIGN_METADATA.
SOURCES_ROOT is an optional absolute path used only to resolve authoritative source pointers.
REVIEW_OUTPUT_PATH is an optional report output path.
REWRITE_REFERENCES defaults to true and may be true or false.
ALLOW_STATUS_APPEND defaults to true and may be true or false.
AUTHORITATIVE_STATUS_STATE supplies a known lifecycle token when the caller owns the lifecycle transition.
TaskProfile NONE means the skill runs in generic TASK shell mode without a profile.
The skill reads only the target KTY metadata surfaces, selected operational memory, optional drift-observation content, decomposition material, and needed source pointers.
The read boundary includes the target KTY _CONTEXT.md file.
The read boundary includes the target KTY _STATUS.md file.
Sibling _MEMORY.md or MEMORY.md may be read only as non-authoritative operational context paired with _STATUS.md.
The read boundary includes the target KTY _REFERENCES.md file.
Optional Scoping.md and KA-*.md reads are for drift observation only.
Decomposition material under DECOMPOSITION_REF may be read as the truth source.
Source pointer paths under SOURCES_ROOT may be read only when needed.
The skill write boundary is limited to _CONTEXT.md, _STATUS.md, _REFERENCES.md, and the optional REVIEW_OUTPUT_PATH.
The skill must not write Scoping.md, KA-*.md, or any decomposition file.
A typical kty-metadata-align task aligns _CONTEXT.md after a KTY rename, category move, or scope change.
A typical kty-metadata-align task appends a lifecycle correction to _STATUS.md when the invoking workflow owns the authoritative state.
A typical kty-metadata-align task refreshes _REFERENCES.md after decomposition or source-pointer changes.
A typical kty-metadata-align task classifies remaining stale Scoping.md or KA-* files as rerun work.
The kty-metadata-align skill is metadata-only by design.
REPORT_ONLY mode is safe for audit follow-up.
Content regeneration should use domain-documents rather than kty-metadata-align.
A valid run requires KTY_PATH to exist and resolve to exactly one KTY-* folder.
A valid run requires decomposition to produce one unambiguous KTY truth row for the target folder.
A valid run classifies observed issues into REPAIRED_NOW, RERUN_LATER, and UNRESOLVED.
REPORT_ONLY runs do not modify metadata files.
ALIGN_METADATA runs modify only files explicitly authorized in AllowedWriteTargets.
Any _STATUS.md edit must be append-only and evidence-backed.
Whenever _STATUS.md is read, sibling _MEMORY.md or MEMORY.md is read when present as non-authoritative operational context.
No files other than _CONTEXT.md, _STATUS.md, _REFERENCES.md, and the optional report may be modified.
When _CONTEXT.md is rewritten, its title must match the form # Context: {KTY-ID}.
A rewritten _CONTEXT.md must contain Name, Category, Discipline, Type, Responsible, CanonicalSchema, IntendedUsers, WhenUsed, Description, Anticipated Artifacts, and Decomposition Reference.
Missing decomposition values in _CONTEXT.md appear as TBD rather than invented prose.
A modified _STATUS.md file must change append-only.
An appended _STATUS.md line must identify the authoritative status or alignment basis.
The skill must not invent a lifecycle state unsupported by the brief or existing evidence.
A rewritten _REFERENCES.md file must remain a references container.
Authoritative references in _REFERENCES.md must remain distinct from notes.
Preserved manual notes in _REFERENCES.md must not be silently promoted to authoritative pointers.
If drift is observed in Scoping.md or KA-* files, the report or task output must name the affected files.
If stale content is observed, the run must state that no content-file edits were performed.
Follow-on content issues must be classified as RERUN_LATER or UNRESOLVED.
A clean run reports the target KTY ID.
A clean run reports the mode used.
A clean run reports any files modified.
A clean run reports whether any follow-on reruns remain.
The skill metadata name is kty-metadata-align.
The skill reviews and optionally aligns one DOMAIN Knowledge Type folder metadata surface to approved decomposition truth without rewriting Scoping.md or KA content.
The skill is compatible with Chirality TASK in generic shell mode and no profile.
The chirality-skill-version metadata value is 1.
The chirality-task-profile metadata value is NONE.
The skill reviews and optionally aligns the metadata surface of one DOMAIN Knowledge Type folder.
The skill aligns metadata to approved decomposition truth and current lifecycle evidence.
KTY-local _CONTEXT.md, _STATUS.md, and _REFERENCES.md are derived metadata in package-role terms.
KTY-local derived metadata aligns to authoritative decomposition truth rather than the reverse.
The decomposition package consists of the main document, authoritative companion registers, and _ScopeChange state.
The decomposition package is the source of truth for KTY-local metadata alignment.
KTY-local metadata is a downstream consumer of decomposition truth.
When the skill reads _STATUS.md, it also reads sibling _MEMORY.md or MEMORY.md when present.
Memory files are non-authoritative operational context only.
Memory files can explain prior local runs or caveats.
Memory files must not override approved decomposition truth or SCA state.
The skill supports REPORT_ONLY mode and ALIGN_METADATA mode.
Metadata-safe writes are limited to _CONTEXT.md, _STATUS.md, and _REFERENCES.md.
The skill never rewrites Scoping.md, KA-*.md, _DEPENDENCIES.md, _MEMORY.md, or publication artifacts.
If content files appear stale after metadata alignment, the skill reports a follow-on rerun instead of widening scope.
The skill runs under TASK in generic shell mode with no profile.
Typical dispatchers include root remediation loops after domain-documents.
Typical dispatchers include SCOPE_CHANGE follow-on closure work.
Typical dispatchers include targeted KTY metadata cleanup after audit findings.
ScopePath is a required absolute path to one KTY-* folder.
AllowedWriteTargets is required and must include the report path plus any metadata files explicitly authorized for alignment.
RuntimeOverrides.KTY_PATH is required and normally equals ScopePath.
RuntimeOverrides.DECOMPOSITION_REF is required and identifies the decomposition root or document used as truth source.
RuntimeOverrides.MODE is required and selects REPORT_ONLY or ALIGN_METADATA.
RuntimeOverrides.SOURCES_ROOT is optional and provides the shared source or reference root for resolving authoritative source pointers.
RuntimeOverrides.REVIEW_OUTPUT_PATH is an optional markdown report path.
RuntimeOverrides.REWRITE_REFERENCES is a true-or-false option that defaults to true.
RuntimeOverrides.ALLOW_STATUS_APPEND is a true-or-false option that defaults to true.
RuntimeOverrides.AUTHORITATIVE_STATUS_STATE is an optional lifecycle state to append when the invoking workflow owns the state transition.
KTY_PATH must be an absolute path to one KTY-* folder.
DECOMPOSITION_REF must be an absolute decomposition truth source path.
MODE must be REPORT_ONLY or ALIGN_METADATA.
SOURCES_ROOT is an optional absolute path for source-material reference resolution.
REVIEW_OUTPUT_PATH is an optional path inside AllowedWriteTargets.
REWRITE_REFERENCES defaults to true and accepts true or false.
ALLOW_STATUS_APPEND defaults to true and accepts true or false.
AUTHORITATIVE_STATUS_STATE may be OPEN, INITIALIZED, SEMANTIC_READY, IN_PROGRESS, CHECKING, ISSUED, or RETIRED.
Reads are limited to the target KTY metadata files, optional local context files, decomposition truth, and needed source pointers.
The read boundary includes {KTY_PATH}/_CONTEXT.md.
The read boundary includes {KTY_PATH}/_STATUS.md.
The read boundary includes {KTY_PATH}/_MEMORY.md or {KTY_PATH}/MEMORY.md when paired with _STATUS.md as non-authoritative operational context.
The read boundary includes {KTY_PATH}/_REFERENCES.md.
The read boundary includes optional {KTY_PATH}/Scoping.md and {KTY_PATH}/KA-*.md for drift observation only.
The read boundary includes decomposition materials under {DECOMPOSITION_REF}.
The read boundary includes source pointers under {SOURCES_ROOT} only when needed.
The skill must not scan sibling KTY folders.
The skill must not infer truth from unrelated roots.
Writes are limited to optional REVIEW_OUTPUT_PATH, _CONTEXT.md, _STATUS.md, and _REFERENCES.md.
Only files explicitly authorized in AllowedWriteTargets may be modified.
The skill is reasoning-first only.
The allowed-tools frontmatter field is intentionally omitted.
The skill disallows edits to Scoping.md, KA-*.md, _DEPENDENCIES.md, _MEMORY.md, and any decomposition file.
The skill disallows invention of source paths, lifecycle state, or decomposition fields.
The skill disallows silent deletion of human-authored reference notes unless the brief explicitly authorizes replacement.
Step 0 validates that KTY_PATH exists and resolves to exactly one KTY-* folder.
Step 0 resolves the matching KTY row from DECOMPOSITION_REF.
Step 0 validates that every repair target is explicitly authorized by AllowedWriteTargets.
If the KTY row cannot be identified uniquely, the run status is FAILED_INPUTS.
Step 1 extracts canonical metadata from decomposition truth without invention.
Canonical metadata includes KnowledgeTypeID.
Canonical metadata includes Knowledge Type Name.
Canonical metadata includes Category ID.
Canonical metadata includes Category Name.
Canonical metadata includes Discipline.
Canonical metadata includes Type.
Canonical metadata includes Responsible.
Canonical metadata includes Description.
Canonical metadata includes AnticipatedArtifacts.
Canonical metadata includes CanonicalSchema.
Canonical metadata includes IntendedUsers.
Canonical metadata includes WhenUsed.
Canonical metadata includes the decomposition reference path.
Canonical metadata includes any authoritative source pointer or SourceSpan available for the KTY.
Absent decomposition truth fields are represented as TBD rather than inferred.
Step 2 reviews _CONTEXT.md for identity, category, and description drift.
Step 2 reviews _STATUS.md for append-only lifecycle validity and obvious contradiction with AUTHORITATIVE_STATUS_STATE when provided.
Step 2 reviews _MEMORY.md or MEMORY.md as non-authoritative operational caveats when present.
Step 2 reviews _REFERENCES.md for stale or contradictory authoritative pointers.
Step 2 reviews Scoping.md and KA-* only to decide whether content regeneration follow-up is still needed.
Step 2 classifies each observed issue as REPAIRED_NOW, RERUN_LATER, or UNRESOLVED.
Metadata alignment repairs are performed only when MODE equals ALIGN_METADATA.
ALIGN_METADATA mode rewrites _CONTEXT.md to aligned decomposition truth.
If REWRITE_REFERENCES is true, ALIGN_METADATA mode normalizes _REFERENCES.md so authoritative pointers are current and preserved notes remain non-authoritative.
If ALLOW_STATUS_APPEND is true and a status correction is unambiguous, ALIGN_METADATA mode appends a correction line to _STATUS.md.
ALIGN_METADATA mode never invents a new lifecycle state.
If AUTHORITATIVE_STATUS_STATE is absent and a status correction requires judgment, the skill reports instead of editing _STATUS.md.
When Scoping.md or KA-* appears inconsistent with aligned metadata, the skill does not edit those files.
When Scoping.md or KA-* appears inconsistent with aligned metadata, the skill reports the exact files.
When Scoping.md or KA-* appears inconsistent with aligned metadata, the skill classifies the issue as RERUN_LATER.
When REVIEW_OUTPUT_PATH is provided, the skill writes a report.
A metadata alignment report title has the form # KTY Metadata Alignment — {KTY-ID}.
A metadata alignment report includes KTY path, decomposition ref, mode, and review date.
A metadata alignment report summarizes repaired now, rerun later, and unresolved issues.
A metadata alignment report lists files modified in the run, if any.
A metadata alignment report includes an explicit RUN_STATUS.
Skill outputs may include an optional report at REVIEW_OUTPUT_PATH.
Skill outputs may include an updated _CONTEXT.md.
Skill outputs may include an updated _STATUS.md.
Skill outputs may include an updated _REFERENCES.md.
Single-KTY scope means one invocation aligns one KTY folder only.
_CONTEXT.md aligns to approved decomposition truth rather than existing draft prose.
The direction of truth flow is authoritative decomposition package to KTY-local metadata.
_STATUS.md changes must be append-only and authority-backed.
Missing source pointers or lifecycle evidence remain reported rather than guessed.
The skill operates on KTY-local metadata surfaces only.
The skill must not modify the canonical working package, authoritative companion registers, _ScopeChange state, or derived publication artifacts.
QA expects the target KTY ID to be explicit.
QA expects the run to separate REPAIRED_NOW, RERUN_LATER, and UNRESOLVED.
QA expects any _STATUS.md modification to be append-only and evidence-backed.
QA expects stale Scoping.md or KA-* content to be surfaced as follow-on work rather than silently rewritten.
The preferred tool order starts with reading decomposition truth for the target KTY.
The preferred tool order reads existing _CONTEXT.md, _STATUS.md, paired memory, and _REFERENCES.md.
The preferred tool order classifies observed drift into REPAIRED_NOW, RERUN_LATER, or UNRESOLVED.
The preferred tool order repairs authorized metadata files only in ALIGN_METADATA mode.
The preferred tool order writes the optional report and follow-on recommendations.
The skill has no TASK-enforced deterministic allowlist.
The skill declares no operational deterministic helpers.
Reasoning governs matching the folder to one decomposition KTY row.
Reasoning governs determining whether lifecycle drift is unambiguous.
Reasoning governs preserving human-authored reference notes while keeping authoritative pointers current.
Reasoning governs deciding when content drift requires rerun rather than metadata editing.
The tool policy disallows edits outside _CONTEXT.md, _STATUS.md, _REFERENCES.md, and the optional report path.
The tool policy disallows rewriting Scoping.md, KA-*.md, _DEPENDENCIES.md, _MEMORY.md, or unauthoritative lifecycle semantics.
The tool policy disallows using _MEMORY.md or MEMORY.md as decomposition truth or lifecycle authority.
The tool policy disallows invented SourceSpan, source paths, or lifecycle states.
The tool policy disallows silent deletion of human-authored notes unless the brief explicitly authorizes replacement.
The tool-policy write boundary is limited to _CONTEXT.md, _STATUS.md, _REFERENCES.md, and optional REVIEW_OUTPUT_PATH.
No other files may be created or modified by the skill.
